# Sheepshead Trainer: Trump Play

> Sheepshead Trainer is a free Sheepshead card game practice app for iPhone and iPad. Five-minute drills on trump order, picking, the bury and trick play.

## App

- [Sheepshead Card Game Practice App | Sheepshead Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/sheepshead/index.html.md): Sheepshead Trainer is a free Sheepshead card game practice app for iPhone and iPad. Five-minute drills on trump order, picking, the bury and trick play.
